items.name: DemandKind
items.summary: What kind of cross-module demand an edge represents.

items.name: report_json
items.summary: Serialize a demand tree alongside per-module step info as a pretty- printed JSON document for `pyrefly check --report-demand-tree`. `module_steps` should pair each module's name with the highest step it reached during the run.

items.name: DemandCollector
items.summary: A demand-tree collection session. Cloning produces another handle to the same underlying roots (the collector is reference-counted internally).

methods.name: enter
methods.signature: fn enter(&self, from: impl fmt::Display, target: impl fmt::Display, key: impl fmt::Debug) -> DemandSpan<'_>
methods.summary: Open a demand span for a cross-module Answer lookup. Hold the returned guard for the duration of the demand — dropping the guard (including on unwind) closes the span and attaches it to its parent, keeping enter/exit balanced even across p…

methods.name: exports_event
methods.signature: fn exports_event(&self, from: impl fmt::Display, target: impl fmt::Display, reason: &str)
methods.summary: Record a leaf event for an Exports-level demand. `reason` identifies which `LookupExport` method triggered the demand.

methods.name: load_event
methods.signature: fn load_event(&self, from: impl fmt::Display, target: impl fmt::Display, reason: &str)
methods.summary: Record a leaf event for a Load-level demand. `reason` identifies which `LookupExport` method triggered the demand.

methods.name: take_roots
methods.summary: Take the collected tree roots, leaving the collector empty.

items.name: DemandEdge
items.summary: One observed cross-module demand: an edge from `from` to `target` carrying what was demanded (`kind`). Edges form a tree because Answer demands open spans that nest other demands made while computing them.

items.name: DemandSpan
items.summary: RAII guard for an in-flight Answer demand span. Dropping the guard — whether via normal control flow or unwind — pops the span off the per-thread stack and attaches it to its parent (or to the collector's roots if no parent is in flight).
